title: DocumenterOutput
description: Structured return for the documenter subagent: docs changed, added, removed, a summary, and follow-ups.

summary.description: One-line description of the documentation change.

follow_up.description: Follow-up tasks, e.g. index or tag registrations still needed.

confidence.description: Calibrated confidence in this return (0 = no confidence, 1 = certain).

comments_pruned.description: Source files whose comments were pruned by the terminal comment-pruning step.

file.description: Path of the source file whose comment text was removed or rewritten.

removed.description: Number of comment blocks removed or rewritten in that file.

prune_verification.description: Outcome of the comment-only self-check over the pruning diff.
